# DILA case-law fixtures (France)

Nine decisions, each file exactly as the DILA distributes it (one XML file per decision), retrieved on 2026-10-14 from
`https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/<DB>/`. Licence: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0, as stated by the DILA data sheets
(`DILA_CONSTIT_Presentation_20170824.pdf`, `DILA_CASS_Presentation_20170824.pdf`, `DILA_JADE_Presentation_20171212.pdf`);
source: Direction de l'information légale et administrative (DILA). The text of the Cour de cassation and Conseil d'État decisions is pseudonymised by the
publisher. See `config/sources/fr-dila-*.yaml`.

| File | Decision | From | What it shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CONSTEXT000045243083.xml` | Cons. const., 7 janv. 2022, n° 2021-960 QPC | `Freemium_constit_global_20250713-140000.tar.gz` | 21 numbered paragraphs, ECLI, links to the Constitution and to codes |
| `CONSTEXT000017665602.xml` | Cons. const., 18 mai 1971, n° 71-42 DC | same | a DC decision of the 1970s, "Considérant que" paragraphs |
| `CONSTEXT000017667265.xml` | Cons. const., 4 nov. 1993, n° 93-1615 AN | same | an electoral decision with an operative part ("Décide :") |
| `JURITEXT000007015983.xml` | Cass. ass. plén., 25 oct. 1985, n° 83-11.960 | `Freemium_cass_global_20250713-140000.tar.gz` | an old published decision: headnotes, no numbered paragraphs |
| `JURITEXT000050221552.xml` | Cass. ass. plén., 11 sept. 2024, n° 23-12.695 | same | numbered paragraphs, headnotes, ECLI, links to the Code civil |
| `JURITEXT000051744508.xml` | Cass. avis, 12 juin 2025, n° 25-70.009 | `CASS_20250707-210159.tar.gz` | the Court's own list of texts applied (`LIENS`) |
| `CETATEXT000051408975.xml` | CE, 31 mars 2025, n° 493033 | `JADE_20250712-211706.tar.gz` | Conseil d'État, ECLI, numbered paragraphs, "1°)" not taken as a paragraph |
| `CETATEXT000051764351.xml` | T. confl., 2 juin 2025, n° C4338 | same | published in the Lebon collection: headnotes, some with broken characters as published |
